propositions: LLM-Review -1 votes carry two distinct meanings (real findings vs. infrastructure vetoes), and today contributors have no self-service remedy for infrastructure vetoes except amending to spin a new patchset or waiting for operator /rerun

A contributor-triggerable 'recheck-review' Gerrit comment must re-run LLM-Review only when the current-revision vote tag is NOT a real finding (coverage-gap sub-reasons, merge-review, retries-exhausted escalation, or PASS are eligible; [LLM-Review: BLOCK — finding] and its merge form are refused)

The retrigger mechanism must reset the per-revision retry budget (via dedup.reset_attempts) and re-enqueue through the existing _rebar_force path, reusing the fail-closed review pipeline without introducing a new vote-write path

Eligibility must be determined privileged-side from durable Gerrit state (fetching the bot's current-revision message tag via GET /a/changes/{id}/messages), never from the contributor's comment text, and the reply must post a message-only comment with no labels key in the REST body

The bot's own comments and comments lacking the 'recheck-review' token must be silent no-ops; real findings and gate-disabled states must receive a refusal reply explaining the fix path, emitting RETRIGGER_REFUSED log markers

The /rerun operator endpoint must also reset the attempts budget before enqueueing to harmonize with 0347's bounded-retry semantics, while retaining unrestricted operator-level semantics (able to force even a finding review)
